shortDescription: Alpha bank, Greece's fourth-largest by market value, on Thursday said it expects its profit to reach or exceed €1.4 billion by 2030, on strong net interest income, loan growth and diversified income sources.

children: Alpha bank, Greece's fourth-largest by market value, on Thursday said it expects its profit to reach or exceed €1.4 billion by 2030, on strong net interest income, loan growth and diversified income sources.
Alpha bank estimates that its  earnings per share will  rise to €0.63 in 2030 from €0.41 in 2026
It projects net credit expansion of €3 billion annually, largely funded by deposits
The bank expects net interest income of €2.3 billion by 2030
More than €4 billion will be available for distributions or deployment between 2027 and 2030, the bank said
